description: Create a new game on GrowBlocks and link the folder to it. address: 3-32 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes (its URL, game.html?g=<address>). Ask the human for the name and address first. A logo (WebP, under 22 KB) and a description are needed before submitting.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).
